selection_rationale: DAWs cover the post/broadcast references (Pro Tools, Nuendo, Pyramix) and the music/education tools common in French schools (Logic Pro, Ableton Live, REAPER). Dante Controller and Dante Virtual Soundcard are the standard tools for the Dante networks found in the other equipment files. QLab is the theatre playback reference. Soundvision, ArrayCalc, EASE Focus and EASE cover manufacturer and generic system prediction. iZotope RX and Adobe Audition cover restoration and editing. Merging and Avid main sites blocked fetches, so some fields rely on knowledge-base or partner pages.
